overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: only one selectman was in the informal hiring group, so no quorum deliberated, and no subcommittee was created. The authority claim was declined as outside the law.

allegations.summary: A group of one Board member, the town administrator and the highway superintendent allegedly interviewed highway job candidates outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: as only one member of the Board was part of the informal group, and therefore at no time did a quorum of the Board deliberate outside of a meeting or otherwise violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The informal hiring group allegedly was a subcommittee of the Board that had to meet under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Board had no role in creating or structuring the informal group, we find that no subcommittee was created.

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the informal group interviewed candidates without authority to do so.
allegations.key_passage: The allegation that the group acted without authorization is beyond the scope of the Open Meeting Law.
